title: Despre Dev.Play si sprijinul industriei locale de game development
methodology: Association public statement; no method, company frame, or worker-status definition supplied.
assessment: Primary association evidence for an approximate early benchmark of around 6,000 employees. Keep separate from later collaborator-inclusive snapshots.
next_step: No exact annual source-native headcount located for 2015-2017; do not convert the approximation to a precise series point.

title: The Romanian Game Development Industry
methodology: Report states it used publicly available material, discussions, and forms filled in by industry members; it disclaims audit.
assessment: Confirms the existing 2018 '6000+' lower bound and says the industry had more than 103 studios and more than 6,000 employees. No collaborator treatment in the headline.
next_step: Retain existing lower-bound observation only; no revision found.

title: The Industry and the Labor Market / Romanian Industry Report 2021
years: 2020 observation; report page dated 29 October 2021; worker survey conducted at the beginning of 2021
methodology: Headline report based on public material, discussions, and industry-member forms; not audited. A separate Employee/Collaborator Survey was completed by 37 companies.
assessment: Primary evidence for '6000+ employees' in 2020. The survey reports 94.7% full-time employees or collaborators, 3.9% project-based collaborators, and 1.71% part-time collaborators or employees; these are composition shares, not a national headcount. Revenue is stated as data reported to tax authorities, but the report does not say that the headcount is drawn from, or reconciled to, company financial filings.
access_status: full_source; downloaded original retained in raw/
next_step: Keep 2020 as a strict lower bound and do not splice it to 2021+ collaborator-inclusive points.

title: RGDA's General Assembly
methodology: Association snapshot; the slide gives no company frame, sampling method, or employee/collaborator split.
assessment: Primary source for 6,700 employees and collaborators, +12% versus 2020. It establishes a new explicitly collaborator-inclusive label, so 2020's employee-only wording remains non-comparable.
access_status: full_source; image-first PDF, search-indexed text verified; downloaded original retained in raw/
next_step: Add as collaborator-inclusive series point only.

title: Romanian video-games industry development 2022
methodology: Association infographic; method not stated on the recorded headline.
assessment: Existing 6,800 employees/collaborators point. No retrospective revision found in later primary material.

title: Romanian video-games industry development 2023
methodology: Association infographic; headline labels the measure 'Employees/collabs'.
assessment: Existing rounded 6,600 employees/collaborators point. Its reported EUR317m turnover and EUR48,154 turnover per employee imply an unreported denominator near 6,583, showing that the displayed 6,600 is rounded.
next_step: Do not replace 6,600 with an implied denominator.

title: Romania game development industry in 2024
methodology: Association/bank industry report; headcount headline says '6,100 employees' and publication does not disclose employee/contractor split or a revision table.
assessment: Existing employee-wording 2024 point. The reported -7.4% is compatible with a 2023 denominator around 6,588 and therefore with the prior rounded 6,600 display, but does not publish a revised 2023 count. The new wording alone does not prove collaborators were excluded.
next_step: Keep 2024 as its own employee-wording series; do not derive an exact prior-year count from -7.4%.

title: Institutul National de Statistica
years: Checked for 2015-2024 dedicated national game-development employment series
methodology: Official statistical portal; no dedicated game-development workforce series identified in the bounded search.
assessment: No source-native government headcount found. Broad industry classifications would not isolate game development and would have a different population from RGDA's studio compilation.
access_status: portal reachable; no relevant dedicated series located
next_step: Do not substitute a broad CAEN/IT series for RGDA's game-industry headcount without an explicit concordance and extract.
